summary: Frontend-only testing completed for flexible currency handling feature. All 7 requested features verified working: Homepage loads, SuperAdmin Dashboard Settings has Backend Default Currency selector with 5 options and priority explanation, EventBuilder has currency selector for organizers, EventView shows charge currency notice and DisplayCurrencySelector, DisplayCurrencySelector shows 5 options with flags and display-only warning, changing display currency triggers 'currencyChanged' event, and EventPriceDisplay resolves currency priority correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ currencyService.ts: Currency priority logic correctly implemented - Event Currency → Backend Default → USD
✅ UI.tsx: EventPriceDisplay component correctly resolves charge currency using getChargeCurrency()
✅ UI.tsx: DisplayCurrencySelector has proper warning 'Display only. Payment uses event currency.'
✅ SuperAdminDashboard.tsx: Backend Default Currency section has all 5 currencies and priority explanation
✅ EventBuilder.tsx: Currency selector in Step 3 (Tickets) with all 5 currency options
✅ EventView.tsx: Charge currency notice '💳 Charged in {currency} (event currency)' with DisplayCurrencySelector
test_credentials: Mock organizer/superadmin user injected via localStorage for testing authenticated flows
seed_data_creation: None - used existing events in system
context_for_next_testing_agent: All currency handling features verified working. Key findings: 1) Homepage loads at localhost:3000, 2) SuperAdmin Dashboard Settings tab has Backend Default Currency selector with USD/EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD options and Currency Priority Logic explanation (Event→Backend Default→USD), 3) EventBuilder Step 3 (Tickets) has Event Currency selector with 5 options, 4) EventView shows '💳 Charged in USD (event currency)' notice with compact DisplayCurrencySelector, 5) DisplayCurrencySelector dropdown shows 5 currencies with flags (🇺🇸🇪🇺🇬🇧🇨🇦🇦🇺) and warning 'Display only. Payment uses event currency.', 6) Changing display currency fires 'currencyChanged' event and saves to localStorage('openticket_currency'), 7) EventPriceDisplay shows price in charge currency with currency code.

superadmin_backend_default_currency.details: Settings tab has Backend Default Currency selector with 5 options (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD), currency priority explanation showing 3 levels, and Save Currency Settings button

eventbuilder_currency_selector.details: Step 3 (Tickets) has Event Currency selector with 5 options: $ USD - US Dollar, € EUR - Euro, £ GBP - British Pound, C$ CAD - Canadian Dollar, A$ AUD - Australian Dollar

eventview_charge_notice.details: EventView shows '💳 Charged in USD (event currency)' notice in blue banner with DisplayCurrencySelector on the right

display_currency_selector.details: Compact DisplayCurrencySelector shows 5 currency options with flags (🇺🇸🇪🇺🇬🇧🇨🇦🇦🇺) and warning 'Display only. Payment uses event currency.'

currency_changed_event.details: Changing display currency from USD to EUR triggers 'currencyChanged' event and saves preference to localStorage

event_price_display.details: EventPriceDisplay shows price as '$50.00 (USD)' using charge currency with currency code
